data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 10
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Thais secure two berths for track worlds
data.description: Thailand have booked two places at the UCI Track World Championships in Shanghai next month, after the national sprint team and a lone rider in the men's 1km time trial earned qualification on the back of strong recent form.

data.title: 'Gourmet Market Reimagined'  offers exclusive accessories
data.description: The whimsical charm of Alice In Wonderland has been transformed into an everyday wonder experience through "Gourmet Market Reimagined", an exclusive collection of lifestyle accessories, home essentials and locally crafted gourmet treats, which is available at all branches of Gourmet Market.

data.title: Siam Society hosts trip to Karnataka in India
data.description: Siam Society is holding a study trip to Karnataka, one of India's most historically and culturally rich regions, from Dec 1-9.

data.title: How hot can the US-Canada trade war get?
data.description: TORONTO (CANADA) - The US-Canada trade war has escalated rapidly, rupturing what was once one of the world's closest economic partnerships.

data.title: NBTC meeting fails for ninth time over quorum
data.description: The National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) failed to hold a meeting for the ninth consecutive time on Wednesday due to an incomplete quorum, leaving 193 agenda items, including 82 urgent matters, unresolved.

data.title: Spikers continue winning run, reach Asian quarters
data.description: Thailand claimed their third straight win in the preliminary phase of the AVC Men's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 in Japan and qualified for the quarter-finals as Pool C winners.

data.title: Buriram pick Silva, Sailors land Jackson
data.description: Buriram United have appointed Mario Silva as head coach, turning to the former Porto youth-team architect to lead the Thai League champions into the 2026-27 season, as his predecessor Mark Jackson resurfaces at Singapore's Lion City Sailors.

data.title: Evacuations in Malibu after waves open sinkhole at Nicolas Cage's house
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - People living in an upmarket coastal stretch of Malibu were under an evacuation order Wednesday after a giant sinkhole opened up on the driveway of a beachfront home belonging to Oscar-winning US actor Nicolas Cage.

data.title: Deportee swap sees nine wanted figures return
data.description: Authorities received 66 Thai nationals returning from Cambodia on Wednesdaycwhile deporting 69 Cambodians after the Khlong Luek border checkpoint in Sa Kaeo was closed.

data.title: Chinese deepfake suspect arrested over crypto theft
data.description: A Chinese man wanted in China over the alleged theft of 162 million baht in cryptocurrency has been arrested at a condo in Pattaya.

data.title: Govt steps up SMR preparations
data.description: The government is stepping up preparations for small modular reactors (SMRs), with work on regulation, skills, waste management and supply chains.

data.title: Deportation 'maintains public order'
data.description: The Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) on Wednesday said deportation was one of several measures available to maintain public order, warning that foreigners who break the law could face stronger legal action.

data.title: Jewish New Year bash in Phuket triggers warning
data.description: PHUKET: Authorities have raised security and tourism-image concerns over a planned Jewish New Year, or Rosh Hashanah, celebration at Chabad House Patong on Friday.

data.title: BJT slams march to pressure EC on Senate case
data.description: The Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) has questioned the appropriateness of People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut leading a march to pressure the Election Commission (EC) ahead of its decision on the alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

data.title: Govt shrugs off AI's blue senators link
data.description: The government played down an incident involving the TH-AI Passport project after a word-and-colour game linked "senators" with blue, the colour associated with the Bhumjaithai Party (BJT).

data.title: City orders checks on 47 data centres
data.description: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt has ordered inspections of 47 data centres to assess their energy use, safety systems and potential environmental impact on nearby residents.

data.title: MPs call for cuts to Interior Ministry's 2027 budget
data.description: Opposition MPs called for cuts to the Interior Ministry's 2027 budget, questioning the cost-effectiveness and transparency of several projects and procurement schemes.

data.title: Thais, Laos tackle forest fires, air pollution, haze threats
data.description: Thailand and Laos are working on environmental protection and cross-border connectivity, with both sides focusing on tackling forest fires, transboundary haze and PM2.5 pollution while advancing a 1.78-billion-baht bridge project expected to boost trade and tourism.

data.title: 'Alarm bells ringing': US summer heat shatters record
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The contiguous United States has endured its hottest summer on record, a new peak that scientists said should send alarm bells ringing over the increasingly dire impacts of climate change.

data.title: Apple unveils its first foldable smartphone iPhone Duo
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - Apple unveiled its long-awaited first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, on Wednesday, at the company's first launch event since CEO John Ternus took the reins on September 1.
